blocks.raw: <Warn>The dual-threshold passing standard is critical: **70% weighted average overall** AND **no subject below 50%**. A candidate scoring 85% in design but 40% in building science fails — even if the average exceeds 70%. Both conditions must be satisfied simultaneously. This is one of the most commonly tested LEA law concepts.</Warn>

blocks.raw:
<LawCallout code="ra9266" section="Section 15 - Rating System">
CRITICAL: The 50% floor applies INDIVIDUALLY to each subject area, not as an average. A candidate scoring 80% in four subjects but 45% in one subject FAILS, even if the overall average exceeds 70%. Both conditions must be met: (1) General weighted average ≥ 70%, AND (2) No grade below 50% in any subject.
</LawCallout>
